RoInitialize provenance: the exe never calls RoInitialize itself at runtime (CRT __scrt_initialize_winrt is dead via flag [0x1514e00]=0); the MTA comes from vccorlib InitializeData(2) in the _initterm_e table before WinMain. If the patch site were ever moved earlier than the initterm run, the host's RoInitialize would be the first (S_OK, not S_FALSE).
Hooking of vccorlib IBox cells on ARM would be harmful (native returns a constant vtable; generated code stores it to obj+4) - port_instructions[4] says 'if kept keep the span' without this warning.
